name: Microgrid inverter reactive-capability limiter
aliases: microgrids Microgrid voltage and reactive-power controls
summary: Restrains the assigned inverter reactive target to its declared operating capability.
description: Restrains the assigned inverter reactive target to its declared operating capability. Voltage and reactive-power control coordinate the AC operating condition of the microgrid resources. A voltage target, reactive-power target and power-factor target represent different control objectives and should have explicit ownership.

In an islanded microgrid, the assigned reference source supports bus voltage while other compatible resources share reactive demand according to the selected control method. Grid-connected operation can use a different objective at the PCC. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Reactive request and inverter limits” at the input and “Permitted reactive target” at the output. Active-power and thermal limits can reduce capability.
